title: Vacation at the Beach Bungalow Cottage | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rental – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Beach Bungalow Cottage embodies all that is good about the quintessential beach cottage – expansive Gulf views accentuated by simply fabulous furnishings and an open, airy loft. Book today!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Florida’s year-round sunny days and warm temperatures make it the perfect destination for your next vacation no matter what time of year you need a break. While your decision to escape to Florida is easy, planning the rest, including where to go, what fun you’ll have with family and friends, and where to stay are unavoidable tasks. Make one of those tasks a bit easier when you choose the state’s beautiful Emerald Coast, and zero in on the Rosemary Beach® community. You’ll make unforgettable memories while you soak up the sun and stay close to everything you want to see and do while you’re here.

Beach Bungalow Cottage is a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home with room for up to 10 guests to spread out over its 1,900 square feet of living space. Everyone in your group will feel like they’ve stepped into their home away from home that will make the stay in the Rosemary Beach community just a bit more relaxing, while also being close to all the restaurants, shops, attractions and more you’ve come to the area to experience.

Highlights:

• Central A/C

• Master Bedroom (King)

• Gulf View

• Courtyard Entrance

• Beautiful Furnishings and Finishes

• Multiple Restaurants & Shops Within Walking Distance

Ready to Relax

Guests looking for style and relaxation on their respite in the Rosemary Beach community will love Beach Bungalow Cottage. A beach theme fitting of a Gulf view home delights in every nook and cranny of the home from bedrooms to living spaces. Enjoy being close to the sea and everywhere else you want to be including bars, shops, attractions, beach gear and bike rentals, and countless other activities to keep you busy and having fun throughout your stay.

Exterior Features

You can feel the relaxation the moment you drive up to Beach Bungalow Cottage. It’s beachy color scheme of pastel green and blue against a light gray or white is akin to the waters and sand of the Gulf of Mexico you’ll see from your living and bedroom spaces every day of your stay. Drive onto a cobblestone driveway and park your rental inside the two-car garage away from the heat of the Emerald Coast sun. Relax on the overhead balcony or fire up the grill for your favorite meal. Make your way through the courtyard gate where you’ll be greeted with another grilling area, a locking inner gate, and a large courtyard space with trellis and bistro table for two. Enjoy some time in the sun and sea breezes on a lower-level patio with rustic wood bench. From the courtyard you’ll find a set of stairs leading up to the balcony facing the beautiful waters of the Gulf. Savor an informal meal at the provided outdoor dining with optional seating for eight, soak up the sun in a comfortable lounge chair, or pull up a chair to the small built-in shelf to read or sip your morning coffee while gazing out at water. Once you’ve had your fun at the beach, rinse off before heading inside with the outdoor shower on the side of the home.

Interior Amenities

The charming colors of the home’s exterior are repeated throughout the inside of the home as well. Prepare a home-cooked meal in the generously sized and fully equipped kitchen. The expansive concrete counters allow plenty of space for cooking and meal prep, including an island with storage space, microwave, and two bar stools is perfect for the chef to spread out and organize ingredients while staying a part of the group. All appliances are stainless steel, and the charming farmhouse sink is a stunning addition. There is plenty of storage space for everything you’ll need to prepare any meal. The cabinetry is painted in the pastel blue color and offers a relaxing ambiance as well as a pop of color against the white walls. Enjoy the meal in the dining area, with rustic wood table and chairs with seating for six. Relax in the beach tones of the living area with doors opening out onto the balcony.

When the day is done or it’s time for a nap, head to a private bedroom. The master suite features a king size bed, plush white linens, a flat screen TV, and private access to outdoor space. Rinse off the sand and salt or prepare for a day of fun in bathroom featuring tiled counter and shower, double sinks, and plenty of storage space for your toiletries. The second bedroom is a loft area where the occupants can overlook the living area of the home. Enjoy a TV show on the wall-mounted flat screen in front of the bed. Small lights to each side of the bed are perfect for reading a book. Recessed lighting in the ceiling in strategic locations give off light from every angle. The kids of the group will love the bunk room. A set of twin-over-twin and a set of full-over-full bunk beds painted the beachy blue found in other elements of the home. Cute “whale tail” coat pegs adorn the end of each top bunk, so the room occupants have a place to put coats or bags if the closet is full of souvenirs. Enjoy a TV show or video game on the flat screen TV in the room. Another bathroom features a frameless shower with rain head and pedestal sink, and the third is conveniently located off of the living area.

Sleeping Accommodations, Sleeps 10

1st Level | Master Bedroom – King w/ ¾ bath

2nd Level | 2nd Bedroom – Full

2nd Level | 3rd Bedroom – One set twin-over-twin bunks; one set full-over-full bunks

Parking:

Street parking only.

Things to Know:

• NO Pets

• Minimum Seven Night, Saturday-Saturday Stay During Spring Break and Summer

• 6 Complimentary adult bicycles

• In-unit laundry

• Plenty of storage

• Tennis

• Wi-Fi

• DVD Player w/DVD Library

Clean and Safe for Your Stay

The Rosemary Beach community is happy to provide guests with clean and safe accommodations throughout your stay. All bedroom and bathroom linens and high-touch surfaces are thoroughly cleaned and disinfected between guest occupancies so you can be sure everything is clean and fresh when you arrive.

Contact Us

No matter when or how long you plan to stay in the Rosemary Beach community, Beach Bungalow Cottage will give you all the rest, relaxation, and fun you’re looking for during your stay on the Emerald Coast. Contact us today to book your memorable stay that will have you coming back for years to come!

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY
